{{Otheruses|Lifeline}}
The '''''Lifeline''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] cargo ship. During the [[Rebellion era]] it was used as a decoy to draw in [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] ships, so it could use its secret weapon, a battery of [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]].
